import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
plugin = root / 'plugins/pacer'
version = json.loads((plugin / 'plugin.json').read_text())['version']
installed = Path('C:/Users/ryanf/.codex/plugins/cache/personal/pacer') / version
paths = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', 'plugins/pacer'], cwd=root, text=True).splitlines()
files = {}
for name in paths:
    source = root / name
    target = installed / source.relative_to(plugin)
    digest = hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    actual = hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if target.is_file() else None
    files[name] = {'source': digest, 'installed': actual, 'match': digest == actual}
assert files and all(row['match'] for row in files.values()), files
sys.path.insert(0, str(installed / 'src'))
os.environ['PYTHONPATH'] = str(installed / 'src')
import pacer_mcp.evidence
import pytest

assert Path(pacer_mcp.evidence.__file__).is_relative_to(installed)
report = {'version': version, 'installed_path': str(installed), 'files': files,
          'evaluator': pacer_mcp.evidence.__file__, 'passed': True}
(root / '.pacer/pac024-installed-identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'matching_files': len(files), 'evaluator': pacer_mcp.evidence.__file__}), flush=True)
raise SystemExit(pytest.main(['plugins/pacer/tests/test_evidence.py', 'plugins/pacer/tests/test_store.py', '-q', '--basetemp=.pacer/pac026-installed-tests']))

import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from uuid import uuid4

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
checkout = root / '.cache/f' / uuid4().hex[:8]
checkout.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
clone_command = ['git', '-c', 'safe.directory=' + (root / '.git').as_posix(), 'clone', '--no-hardlinks', str(root), str(checkout)]
clone = subprocess.run(clone_command, check=False, capture_output=True, text=True)
if clone.returncode:
    failure = {'checkout': str(checkout), 'exit_code': clone.returncode, 'stdout': clone.stdout, 'stderr': clone.stderr}
    (root / '.pacer/pac024-checkout-clone-failure.json').write_text(json.dumps(failure, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
